data.current_description: Same as `/v1/bulk-lookup` (same 10,000-row cap per job, same status/results contract), gated by your plan's daily bulk search quota instead of credits, with unlimited jobs; each accepted submission consumes one search per unique row from the day's quota (`invalid_linkedin_url` rows use none). data.summary_suggestion: Submit bulk email finder job for processing
data.description_suggestion: Submits a bulk email finder job to find deliverable email addresses for multiple LinkedIn profiles or name/domain combinations. Accepts up to 10,000 rows per job. For unlimited-plan subscribers, each accepted submission consumes one search per unique row from the daily quota (invalid LinkedIn URLs consume none). Returns a BulkLookupSubmitResponse with a job_id for tracking. Use the job_id to poll status and retrieve results. Rejected or failed submissions consume no quota.

data.current_description:
Submit a list of LinkedIn company URLs for asynchronous bulk enrichment.
Duplicate companies are charged once; every input row still comes back in
results, in order. Credits are deducted upfront at 1 credit per unique
row, once for the whole job.

Returns a `job_id` immediately. Poll
`GET /v1/company-enrichment/bulk/{job_id}` until `status` reaches
`completed`, then fetch results via
`GET /v1/company-enrichment/bulk/{job_id}/results`.

Every accepted row is charged, including not_found and error rows.
Duplicates and invalid rows cost nothing. Refunds are issued
only when OrbiSearch infrastructure cannot accept or process the
submission itself (the upfront charge is reversed in that case).
